title: Constructible derived comparison for arbitrary finite rings
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $B$ a finite commutative ring. Use the small etale and pro-etale sites, their coefficient sheaves, and the exact derived inverse image $\nu_X^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. The functor $\nu_X^*$ induces an equivalence between bounded etale complexes with constructible cohomology and pro-etale complexes whose cohomology is intrinsically constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and vanishes outside a finite interval. It preserves and reflects each cohomological interval $[a,b]$. In particular every such pro-etale complex has bounded constructible etale origin. No assumption that $B$ is a quotient of a discrete valuation ring is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived (and exact cohomology comparison); applies to every Noetherian ring, hence every finite ring
